scope: Proposition D.1 (Exact correction outside a protected ball) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 141. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer s ≥ 3. There are constants ϵs, Cs > 0 with the following property. Let dB = (δ + aB, bB) be smooth metric and second fundamental form data on R3, with δ + aB positive definite and, for every multi-index α, |∂α aB(y)| ≤ Cα⟨y⟩−1−|α| , |∂α bB(y)| ≤ Cα⟨y⟩−2−|α| . Let ϕ be a smooth compactly supported scalar/covector pair such that supp ϕ ⊂ {|y| ≥ 1}, Φ(dB) = ϕ on |y| ≥ 1. Define the two base sizes βs = ∥aB∥Hs+2 1 + ∥bB∥Hs+1 2 , ηs = ∥ϕ∥Y s . If βs + ηs < ϵs, there is a smooth tensor pair vc = (qc, pc) such that supp vc ⊂ {|y| ≥ 1}, Φ(dB + vc) = 0 on |y| ≥ 1, ∥vc∥Xs ≤ Csηs. The corrected metric remains positive definite. The correction is smooth across |y| = 1 and satisfies symbol bounds of metric weight one and second fundamental form weight two at every order. No smallness is required of these higher bounds. No moment condition is imposed on ϕ, and the correction need not be compactly supported; its tail may change the asymptotic charges. No constraint equation is asserted for the artificially supplied datum on |y| < 1.
